_meta.title: Mechanism guide 2026
_meta.source: La-Z-Boy Product Knowledge Library (Nov 2025 – Jun 2026 issues)
_meta.about: Per-mechanism features and benefits, wall proximity, weight tested, warranty tiers, option benefits and cross-source notes. A prefix not listed here has no mechanism entry; nothing is inferred for it.

slouch.name: Independent reclining back & seat
slouch.benefit: Recline without raising the legrest, with continuous lower-lumbar support. Stretch your back and find the right position at any legrest level. This is the La-Z-Boy “Slouch” position.

slouch-rock.name: Independent reclining back & seat, while rocking
slouch-rock.benefit: Recline while rocking without raising the legrest, with continuous lower-lumbar support. Stretch your back, rock a baby, and find the right position at any legrest level.

slouch-glide.name: Independent reclining back & seat, while gliding
slouch-glide.benefit: Recline while gliding without raising the legrest, with continuous lower-lumbar support. Soothe a baby and find the right position at any legrest level.

legrest-3pos.name: 3-position dual-locking legrest
legrest-3pos.benefit: Three legrest heights to choose from. The dual lock prevents “foot droop”, is safe around kids and pets, and will not collapse under pressure. Use the comfort selector to raise the legrest to the third position before lowering it.

legrest-1pos-glider.name: 1-position dual-locking legrest
legrest-1pos-glider.benefit: Dual-locking, so it is safe around kids and pets and will not collapse under pressure. Using the comfort selector to raise and lower it prevents foot droop. The quiet-closing legrest makes it a popular nursery chair.

ratchet16.name: 16-position ratchet tilt
ratchet16.benefit: With the 3-position legrest and independent back and seat, it gives almost limitless reclining positions, including feet above the heart for circulation and relief for the lower back.

wingnut.name: Wingnut back-tension adjustment
wingnut.benefit: Tunes the chair to the guest’s height and strength. Flip the chair forward and tighten the wingnuts (one per side) for more tension for taller people, or loosen them for less tension for shorter people.

speednut.name: Speed-nut back-tension adjustment
speednut.benefit: Tunes the chair to the guest’s height and strength. Tighten the speed nut for more tension for taller people, loosen it for less for shorter people.

unibody.name: Four-sided unibody frame
unibody.benefit: La-Z-Boy’s four-sided unibody frame adds a fourth, front side for greater stability and durability. The steel back allows a shorter wall distance with a full recline, and the box frame stops the arms splaying apart when getting in and out.

unibody-levelers.name: Four-sided unibody frame with levelers
unibody-levelers.benefit: Same stable four-sided frame, plus levelers that level the unit on hard floors and carpet and add up to an inch of height so the legrest can open and close without obstruction.

track-wheel.name: Track & wheel reclining mechanism
track-wheel.benefit: A metal track-and-wheel system moves the chair away from the wall as it reclines while keeping the stability of a non-rocker, so a full recline fits a tight space.

safety-legrest.name: Safety springs: legrest
safety-legrest.benefit: Safety springs on the power legrest keep kids and pets from being hurt, because the motors are so quiet.

safety-head-leg.name: Safety springs: headrest & legrest
safety-head-leg.benefit: Safety springs on the power headrest and legrest keep kids and pets from being hurt, because the motors are so quiet.

control-4btn.name: 4-button control + USB
control-4btn.benefit: Reclines through power within 6 seconds. The control raises and lowers the legrest and backrest together or separately, and the USB-A port charges devices.

remote-memory.name: Wireless remote with memory & home buttons + USB
remote-memory.benefit: Two memory settings for favourite positions and a 1-touch Home button on both the cradle and the remote. USB-A port in the cradle to charge devices.

headrest.name: Adjustable headrest
headrest.benefit: Raises up to 55 degrees at the touch of a button, so there is no need for a pillow and the neck and head stay supported in almost unlimited positions.

headrest-lumbar.name: Adjustable headrest & lumbar
headrest-lumbar.benefit: Headrest raises up to 55 degrees. The steel scissor-jack lumbar support has a pivoting plate that moves with the guest and can add about 3 inches of lumbar support.

motors-2.name: 2 motors
motors-2.benefit: Independent motors for each function mean less wear on each motor and easy servicing. Emergency battery backup (9-volt batteries not included). 3-year warranty on power components.

motors-3.name: 3 motors
motors-3.benefit: Independent motors for each function mean less wear on each motor and easy servicing. Emergency battery backup (9-volt batteries not included). 3-year warranty on power components.

motors-4.name: 4 motors
motors-4.benefit: Independent motors for each function mean less wear on each motor and easy servicing. Emergency battery backup (9-volt batteries not included). 3-year warranty on power components.

battery-backup.name: Emergency battery backup
battery-backup.benefit: Lets the guest get out of the furniture with one rotation down during a power outage. Replace two 9-volt batteries (not included) once a year, like a smoke detector.

toggle-3.name: 3-toggle control with memory & home + USB
toggle-3.benefit: Headrest, backrest and legrest toggles with two memory settings and a 1-touch Home button. USB-A port charges devices.

toggle-4.name: 4-toggle control with memory & home + USB
toggle-4.benefit: Backrest, legrest, headrest and lumbar toggles with two memory settings and a 1-touch Home button. USB-A port charges devices.

levelers.name: Levelers
levelers.benefit: Level the unit on hard floors and carpet.

motion-independent-motors.name: Independent motors for each function
motion-independent-motors.benefit: Less wear on each motor and easy to service.

drop-table.name: Drop-down table & lower drawer (360 / 36U / 36X sofas)
drop-table.benefit: Drop-down table with a wireless charger, two USB-C ports and two stainless cup holders, plus a soft-close lower drawer under the centre seat. Plug-in required. Order the 360 / 36U / 36X number instead of the standard 330 / 33U / 33X. Available on the styles listed only, and only in Sable (067).

console-bundle.name: Power console bundle (CB / CC / CM)
console-bundle.benefit: Adds a wireless charging tray, two electrical outlets and two USB ports inside the storage tub, two table ports and a choice of tray: black laminate (CB), Coffee 021 wood (CC) or Mahogany 007 wood (CM). The standard console has a lower drawer, two cup holders and a flip-top storage tub. No battery packs on a console.

spring-release.name: Spring-release footrest
spring-release.benefit: Easy to reach, easy to use and discreet. Gently press the footrest down with the legs until it latches. One legrest position.

legrest-tension.name: Legrest tension adjustment
legrest-tension.benefit: Three tension settings, set under each legrest, fit each person’s height and strength.

front-levelers.name: Front foot levelers
front-levelers.benefit: Adjust the height up to an inch for rugs, carpet or hard floors so the legrest raises and lowers without obstruction.

one-button.name: 1-button reclining
one-button.benefit: Press to recline the legrest, keep pressing to recline the backrest.

power-recline-head.name: Power recline & adjustable headrest
power-recline-head.benefit: Press to recline the legrest and keep pressing to recline the backrest. 15-second recline and 15-second return. Adjustable headrest in place of a pillow.

zero-gravity.name: Zero-gravity layout
zero-gravity.benefit: The position can help circulation, and may help reduce back pain and improve posture by decompressing the spine and easing pressure points.

inside-arm-control.name: Inside-arm control with Home button + USB
inside-arm-control.benefit: Two-button rocker switch with a press-and-hold Home button. Quiet motors with USB-A and USB-C ports.

lazmotion-poly.name: La-Z-Motion seat poly construction
lazmotion-poly.benefit: 27 lb core with a 44 lb foundation layer under the seat and a 27 lb foundation under the legrest for a supportive yet cosy sit.

interlock-ce.name: Interlocking frame
interlock-ce.benefit: Overlapping-joint frame of OSB, hardwood solids and laminated hardwood. Extra padding on the front base and arm posts only. Limited lifetime warranty on frame and springs.

interlock-padded.name: Fully padded interlocking frame
interlock-padded.benefit: Padding all round protects people and the upholstery and lets the piece float freely in the room. Limited lifetime warranty on frame, springs and mechanism.

nosag.name: No-sag springs
nosag.benefit: Springs run front to back so there is no “hammock” effect. Each person gets their own seat system, for a supportive wear-in, not a wear-out.

core-single.name: Single-core seat cushion with logo decking
core-single.benefit: One solid supportive layer with a contour-cut comfort layer, stuffed to 120% so it starts crowned and breaks in flat. Self-healing zippers. Logo decking keeps cushions in place and lined up. Seats rotate but are not reversible.

core-comfort.name: Comfort Core seat cushion with logo decking
core-comfort.benefit: Four zones: firmer in the back two-thirds for back support and softer at the front so the circulation behind the knees is not cut off. Self-healing zippers. Logo decking keeps cushions in place and lined up.

corkscrew.name: Double-picked corkscrew poly fill
corkscrew.benefit: Standard fill for toss pillows and back cushions (tight backs excepted). Keeps its shape with easy upkeep. To fluff, remove one insert at a time and tumble-dry with no heat.

saddle-seat.name: Saddle seat construction
saddle-seat.benefit: Sits like a sofa, not a sleeper. The bed frame is recessed so there is no bar felt when sitting next to an arm.

tubular-steel.name: Tubular steel sleep mechanism
tubular-steel.benefit: The lightest, most durable shape. It will not scratch floors, collapse or injure guests.

cross-wire.name: Cross-wire mattress support
cross-wire.benefit: Holds the mattress above the support bars, so there are no bars in the back and guests sleep better.

dual-lock-headrest.name: Dual-locking headrest with mattress retainer
dual-lock-headrest.benefit: Reachable from either side of the mattress. Tilts the head up for reading or TV, or to raise the head for sleeping. The retainer keeps the mattress from sliding to the floor.

duo-one-touch.name: One-touch recline button with USB-A
duo-one-touch.benefit: Front button raises the legrest and stops it anywhere. Back button closes or lowers it. USB-A port with each recliner.

duo-inside-recline.name: Reclining inside back & seat
duo-inside-recline.benefit: The legrest comes out of the sofa like a hidden ottoman, giving the look of a stationary sofa that puts your feet up. The inside recline raises and tilts the seat with continuous back support. La-Z-Boy’s only true zero-wall-clearance recliner.

duo-pivot.name: Pivoting legrest
duo-pivot.benefit: Angle the legrest to suit leg length and how the guest sits.

dc-extended-legrest.name: Extended legrest
dc-extended-legrest.benefit: An extra legrest panel tucks under the seat for more leg support.

dc-2pos.name: 2-position reclining
dc-2pos.benefit: A 2-position tilt-back mechanism for reading, TV or relaxing, in the look of a stationary chair with a hidden recline.

dc-full-ext.name: Full-extension reclining
dc-full-ext.benefit: A counter-balance recline gives multiple positions, in the look of a stationary chair that hides a recline.

dc-cross-supports.name: Frame cross supports
dc-cross-supports.benefit: Two solid-wood cross supports with steel brackets tie the arms to the rest of the chair so they do not splay apart. This is why La-Z-Boy can give a limited lifetime warranty on frame, springs and mechanism parts.

dc-remote.name: Wireless remote with 2 memories, Home button & USB-A
dc-remote.benefit: Remote sits in a magnetic cradle with USB-A, has a remote-locking feature, and returns the guest to upright with the Home button.

dc-1btn.name: 1-button reclining
dc-1btn.benefit: One button raises and lowers the legrest. Stop anywhere.

dc-swivel-high.name: High-leg swivel base
dc-swivel-high.benefit: Swivel-only high-grade steel plate (no rocking) on 360-degree ball bearings, on high legs for an open look.

dc-swivel-track.name: Swivel base (track & wheel)
dc-swivel-track.benefit: Circular swivel mechanism (no rocking) with a 360-degree track and wheels for smooth swivel.

dc-swivel-glide.name: Swivel glider base
dc-swivel-glide.benefit: Front-to-back swing mechanism on a 360-degree ball-bearing circular base.

dc-press-back.name: Press-back reclining
dc-press-back.benefit: Recline with fluid movement and keep continuous lower-lumbar support. Pairs with an ottoman.

ottoman-features.name: Ottoman features
ottoman-features.benefit: Contour-cut foam for the legs. Selected styles add storage, trays, casters or vents.

lift-2btn.name: 2-button control (Bronze)
lift-2btn.benefit: Simple up and down buttons, LED back-lit on Bronze, so the guest can stop anywhere.

lift-1motor.name: 1-motor lift through full recline
lift-1motor.benefit: One motor runs a smooth lift through full recline. Battery backup (two 9-volt batteries, not included) brings the user back to upright for one rotation in a power outage, then the batteries need replacing.

lift-storage.name: Storage pocket
lift-storage.benefit: Extra storage and a place to keep the remote.

lift-articulating.name: Articulating backrest
lift-articulating.benefit: The backrest begins to straighten as the seat lifts, which helps the guest and caregiver with standing.

lift-heat-massage.name: Vibration with heat & massage
lift-heat-massage.benefit: Three vibration patterns at three intensities. Heat in the seat and back at two intensities. Shuts off after 15 minutes, runs two cycles, then needs an hour to cool down.

lift-independent.name: Independently reclining back & legrest
lift-independent.benefit: Sit and recline without raising the legrest. Separate motors per function mean less wear.

lift-zero-g.name: Legrest elevates to zero gravity
lift-zero-g.benefit: The zero-gravity position can help with swelling and circulation.

lift-box-cover.name: Box mechanism cover
lift-box-cover.benefit: A finished look from all angles that keeps dust out of the motors.

lift-backup.name: Emergency battery back-up
lift-backup.benefit: Brings the guest back to upright if power fails.

ES.name: Elongated comfort selector
ES.benefit: Adds 2 inches to the standard comfort-selector handle for better leverage.
ES.pitch: “This longer handle gives you more leverage, so raising and lowering the legrest takes less effort.”

H1.name: Arc comfort selector
H1.benefit: Replaces the standard comfort selector with a brushed-nickel Arc handle. The finish changes the comfort selector.
H1.pitch: “A brushed-nickel handle is a small upgrade you will see and feel every time you recline.”

H3.name: Black Arc comfort selector
H3.benefit: Replaces the standard comfort selector with a matte-black Arc handle.
H3.pitch: “A matte-black handle gives the chair a modern, finished look.”

1H.name: Arc comfort selector
1H.benefit: Replaces the standard handles with a brushed-nickel Arc handle.
1H.pitch: “A brushed-nickel handle is a small upgrade you will see and feel every time you recline.”

3H.name: Black Arc comfort selector
3H.benefit: Replaces the standard handles with a matte-black Arc handle.
3H.pitch: “A matte-black handle gives the chair a modern, finished look.”

2E.name: Elongated comfort selector
2E.benefit: Adds 2 inches to the standard handles for better leverage and an easier recline.
2E.pitch: “This longer handle gives you more leverage, so reclining takes less effort.”

LS.name: Left-hand comfort selector
LS.benefit: Moves the comfort selector to the left side.
LS.pitch: “If you sit on the left side, the handle moves to where your hand naturally falls.”

LE.name: Left elongated comfort selector
LE.benefit: Left-side handle with 2 extra inches of length.
LE.pitch: “The handle moves to the left side and is longer for easier leverage.”

L1.name: Left-hand Arc comfort selector
L1.benefit: Left-side handle, replaced with the brushed-nickel Arc handle.
L1.pitch: “The handle moves to the left side, in a brushed-nickel Arc style.”

L3.name: Left-hand black Arc comfort selector
L3.benefit: Left-side handle, replaced with the matte-black Arc handle.
L3.pitch: “The handle moves to the left side, in a matte-black Arc style.”

FS.name: La-Z-Boy Contour Cushion
FS.benefit: Adds a Contour Cushion foam layer over a high-resiliency foam base for the seat and legrest. The special foam has millions of air capsules that mold to the body for a soothing hug on the back and hips. Raises the foam warranty from 1 year to 3 years.
FS.pitch: “The Contour Cushion molds to your body and relieves pressure points, and it carries a longer foam warranty.”

Z6.name: ComfortCore Plus with Contour Cushion
Z6.benefit: Upgrades the Comfort Core seat cushion to ComfortCore Plus with Contour Cushion, a temperature-resistant foam that contours to the body. Raises the foam warranty from 3 years to 5 years.
Z6.pitch: “This is the most personal seat we make: it contours to you and carries a 5-year foam warranty.”

FP.name: Featherlite pillows
FP.benefit: Upgrades accent pillows to 95% duck feathers and 5% duck down in a down-proof ticking fabric. Raises the foam warranty from 3 years to 5 years on styles where that applies.
FP.pitch: “Featherlite pillows feel plush and hold a softer, more relaxed shape.”

P1.name: Contrasting pillows
P1.benefit: Changes the cover on the accent pillows. Enter the code followed by the contrasting fabric number.
P1.pitch: “Contrasting pillows let you add colour or pattern without changing the whole piece.”

P2.name: Contrasting pillows
P2.benefit: Changes the cover on the accent pillows. Enter the code followed by the contrasting fabric number.
P2.pitch: “Contrasting pillows let you add colour or pattern without changing the whole piece.”

SW.name: Swivel base, manual recliners
SW.benefit: 360-degree, full-race ball-bearing circular base. Available on select styles. Not available on wall recliners or the Summit Series.
SW.pitch: “A swivel base lets you turn toward the TV, the window or the conversation without getting up.”

SL.name: Power swivel base
SL.benefit: 145-degree turn with stoppers for safety on a ball-bearing circular base. Adds 1 inch to overall height. Not available on wall recliners or the Summit Series.
SL.pitch: “It turns part of the way for conversation or the TV, and the stoppers keep it safe.”

LT.name: Left-side sitting control panel
LT.benefit: Moves the mounted controls from right to left side sitting.
LT.pitch: “The controls move to the left side, where you sit.”

LW.name: Left-side wireless remote
LW.benefit: Switches to a left-side sitting mounted cradle with the wireless remote. The cradle includes a remote finder.
LW.pitch: “The remote cradle moves to the left side, with a remote finder in the cradle.”

HW.name: Hand wand
HW.benefit: Replaces the side control panel with a corded hand wand. The cord runs through the centre so either hand can use it. No USB charging with the hand wand.
HW.pitch: “A simple corded hand wand is easy to hold and works with either hand.”

W2.name: Dual wireless remotes
W2.benefit: Replaces the outside toggle controls with two sitting-mounted cradles with wireless remotes. Remote finder in the cradle, both memory settings on the remote and the cradle.
W2.pitch: “Two seats means two remotes, each with its own memory settings.”

T2.name: Dual control panel
T2.benefit: Both sitting positions get a control panel.
T2.pitch: “Each side of the sofa has its own controls.”

CB.name: Power console bundle, black laminate tray
CB.benefit: Adds a wireless charging tray, two outlets and two USB ports inside the storage tub and two table ports, with a black laminate tray. For 339, U39, X39 and SC3. No battery packs.
CB.pitch: “The console charges your phone and keeps drinks and remotes in reach.”

CC.name: Power console bundle, Coffee 021 wood tray
CC.benefit: Adds a wireless charging tray, two outlets and two USB ports inside the storage tub and two table ports, with a Coffee finish 021 wood tray. For 339, U39, X39 and SC3. No battery packs.
CC.pitch: “The console charges your phone and keeps drinks and remotes in reach.”

CM.name: Power console bundle, Mahogany 007 wood tray
CM.benefit: Adds a wireless charging tray, two outlets and two USB ports inside the storage tub and two table ports, with a Mahogany finish 007 wood tray. For 339, U39, X39 and SC3. No battery packs.
CM.pitch: “The console charges your phone and keeps drinks and remotes in reach.”

MA.name: SlumberAir mattress
